GenAiPlugin.description: This topic handles creating new cases or updating existing ones based on user requests. It is triggered when users need assistance with case management.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Gather as much information as possible from the user by asking clarifying questions.
If a user does not have their case number or email, ask if they'd like to escalate to an agent or create a new case.
If user types 4 or 4️⃣ or Create a Case
Offer both options to look up a case by either email address or case number.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to create new cases or update existing ones based on user input. Do not attempt to handle any other types of requests.
